entries.2c0194cabc2c4e4e: It provides services ancillary to passenger transport, including reservation cancellation and change services, baggage handling, pet handling, sales of advertising space using in-flight magazines and in-flight services, lending of flight simulators and aircraft ground vehicles to other airlines, and sales of in-flight merchandise. Ancillary business revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,192 million.
